nodes.label: UX Review & Ideas
nodes.rationale: Diagnosis: the visuals are fine; the interaction layer (feedback, loading, consistency of micro-decisions) causes the rough feel - fixing the feedback model is ~70% of the perceived-quality win. Roadmap ordered by impact / effort.

nodes.label: Single Mutable Status-String Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Seven forms used one status state holding errors, loading text and success, rendered as a permanent grey box: success and error look identical, nothing auto-dismisses, and it reads like a debug log - identified as the biggest perceived-quality offender.

nodes.label: Toast System (sonner) Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Replace every setStatus success/error with toast.success/toast.error; keep inline text only for persistent states. Single change that makes the whole app feel modern; toasts also give aria-live announcements for free.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI (useOptimistic) Recommendation
nodes.rationale: 11 router.refresh calls across 8 components make every action wait for a full server round-trip; React 19 primitives (useOptimistic/useActionState/useFormStatus) were measured at 0 uses despite React 19 + Next 16.

nodes.label: Design Token System (radius/type/spacing)
nodes.rationale: 8 different border radii and 10+ ad-hoc pixel type sizes produce the 'unedged' feel; define 3-4 radii, a 6-step type scale and a spacing rhythm as Tailwind theme tokens, then sweep the codebase.

nodes.label: Styled Confirm Dialog Recommendation
nodes.rationale: window.confirm at account deactivation is jarring, unstyleable and breaks the visual language at a high-stakes moment; replace with a styled Dialog primitive reused for all destructive confirmations.
